recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片四格中可見大片不規則、雲絮狀、質地蓬鬆的淡紫至紫色無定形沉積物，邊緣呈羽毛狀、內部沒有細胞核，周圍散布淋巴球、髓系細胞與少數漿細胞；這種 cloud-like 物質是類澱粉在抹片上的樣貌。
features: Large irregular extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to purple material
Deposits have feathery, finely granular edges and contain no nuclei or cell membranes
Lymphocytes, myeloid cells and occasional plasma cells lie adjacent to or trapped within the deposits
Background red cells in thicker smear areas
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (composite of four fields) show multiple large, irregular extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to purple material with feathery granular borders and no internal nuclei. Lymphocytes, maturing myeloid cells and occasional plasma cells are present around and within the deposits. The appearance is suggestive of amyloid; because fibrin, precipitated protein or crushed cells can look similar on smears, confirmation with Congo red staining (apple-green birefringence) on particles, clot section or biopsy is required. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow involvement by amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Fibrin is fibrillar and platelet aggregates retain granular platelet texture, typically in partially clotted samples, and both are Congo red negative.
Precipitate is dark, crystalline or granular, lies in a different focal plane and is not intimately associated with cells.
Crushed megakaryocytes retain granular cytoplasm with nuclear fragments, and smudge cells show residual nuclear chromatin strands.
